title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for fourth moments
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $d,e:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. Then $\bigl(\mathbb{E}_p[d^2e^2]\bigr)^2\leq \mathbb{E}_p[d^4] \,\mathbb{E}_p[e^4]$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
